Rug.note: AS BUILT (round 3, full rebuild): pile 7.00 x 8.70 ft at local x 5.55..12.55, z 2.30..11.00. Round 2 was 10.05 x 7.05 of one perfectly regular rib field running edge to edge and the critic read it as corrugated board. SIZE is off the photo: the rug's east edge stops just short of the nightstand (rug at photo x ~895, nightstand feet at 920), i.e. at the bed's east rail, and it runs ~1.4 ft west of the bed's west rail. TEXTURE: the photo's rug is not one rib field, it is broad ~0.6 ft horizontal BANDS - some flat cut pile, some looped, some chevroned. Built as ONE smooth height field (56 x 420, ~24.6k verts, averaged normals so there are no facets) with a per-band profile, a 0.145 ft loop pitch, ~0.021 ft peak-to-valley (about half round 2's 0.028) and a per-row jitter of +/-0.0045 ft so no two rows repeat. The perimeter tapers to zero over 0.10 ft and is serrated vertex-by-vertex. VALUE: base #c1c1c0 measures 208 against a 213 wall = 0.98, matching the photo's 172/176 = 0.98. Note the rug cannot out-contrast the photo's floor - the photo has floor 104 / rug 172 (1.65x) while this app renders the floor at 0.98 of the rug, so the separation is carried by the fake contact shadow, not by brightness. FAKE AO (the app renders no shadows at all): #aaaaa9 within 0.55 ft of the bed and #919191 under it, keyed to the bed at local x 7.025..12.475, z 0.15..7.45 - re-run the build if the bed moves. WATCH THE BACKING: it must top out at model y 0, not above the pile. The first round-3 build gave it height PILE+0.02-SKIRT, the backing swallowed the whole pile and the rug rendered as a flat grey mat with white specks. pos.y stays 0.004, NOT 0.010: house.js draws the room slab at y 0.01 and objects.js writes pos.y into the same space, so 0.010 is coplanar with the floor.

_round3: Round 3 closed: Bed (queen rebuild), Wall Art (rescaled 0.857 + moved), Rug (rebuilt, banded), Dresser (rebuilt, narrower, bright layered mirror), Ceiling (ridge off centre at x 9.0), Baseboards (verified already built - status.json was stale). Knock-on moves: Window North -> 5.6, Nightstand -> 13.6, Ceiling Fan -> y 8.10, Chair -> (13.35, 8.9). TOOL FIX made this round, in tools/roomkit/shot.py: the pose-convergence loop only tested camera.position, and on the re-assert the camera is already AT pose.pos, so it broke on frame 1 while controls.target was still lerping away from floorview's recenterFloor goal. Every shot came out yawed off the pose by however little the tween managed in the trailing 300 ms - i.e. worse the heavier the scene. The loop now waits on controls.target too. If your renders ever look mysteriously rotated or zoomed at a correct camera position, that is the mechanism. Build scripts for this round: scratchpad build/b_bed.py, b_rug.py, b_dresser.py, b_ceiling.py, plus proj.py (analytic ref camera), overlay.py and tone.py (exposure 1.15 -> ACES -> sRGB inverse).
